_comment: Lead / integration. Pack-level checks across every module (tools/tests/pack): all server scripts in one scope and the startup scripts in their own, sharing one global, in the instance's Rhino jar; the degradation matrix of IMPLEMENTATION.md 8 (absent, off and broken modules) and the pillar switches of 6.2; the -strict runs expose only the method names KubeJS leaves visible in game (F37), the plain runs both those and the Mojang names; the lint's duplicate-name and hidden-name checks; the Hive Remembers install steps of tools/apply.py. Contract 1.5: every run enforces the Recruits-safe start (spec D invariants (a)-(e)) and the difficulty profile expectations; the matrix gains the EPCA-absent row (no-epca) and no-diff-events; pack-difficulty(-strict) runs the pack at vanilla Peaceful, Easy, Normal and Hard, through a mid-run Easy -> Hard -> Easy switch and on Easy across a /reload and a world restart (diff-1-restart). Invariant (d) checks every live clade host VISUAL tracks against the team its clade and name want, not only the team VISUAL recorded.
